#![allow(unused_imports, dead_code)]
#[path = "<ad4m checkout>/ad4m-identity-core/tests/common/mod.rs"]
mod common;

use ad4m_hash_chain::sha256;
use ad4m_identity_core::inbox::*;
use ad4m_identity_core::link::OfferKind;
use ad4m_identity_core::record::*;
use ad4m_identity_core::{x25519_multikey_of, KeyLife};
use common::*;
use serde_json::json;

fn hexs(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    b.iter().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect()
}

fn main() {
    let browser = dev(4);
    let enc4 = enc_secret(4);
    let log0 = devices_log();
    let mut log1 = devices_log();
    log1.add_key(sealable_device(4, KeyLife::Standing));
    let scid = log0.chain.state().scid.clone();

    // the holder's ticket, sealed to the browser's pre-join inbox
    let signed = signed_offer(
        &log0,
        ad4m_identity_core::link::Offer {
            device_key: Some(mk(&browser)),
            ..link_offer(&log0, OfferKind::Device, None)
        },
    );
    let body = InboxBody::OfferTicket(Box::new(OfferTicket {
        store: "https://store.ad4m.dev".into(),
        scid: scid.clone(),
        offer_id: signed.offer.offer_id.clone(),
        s: bs58::encode(link_secret()).into_string(),
        signed_offer: signed,
    }));
    let payload = sign_payload(mk(&browser), body, LINK_NOW, signed_by(&log0), &master(log0.n)).unwrap();
    let address = pre_address(&mk(&browser), &device_r()).unwrap();
    let sealed_msg = seal(
        &x25519_multikey_of(&enc4),
        &InboxAddress::Pre(address.clone()),
        &payload,
        &mut TestRng::new("fixture ticket"),
    )
    .unwrap();

    // the record after the link: the browser is d4, d1 answers sign-ins
    let mut rec = record_fixture();
    {
        let d1 = rec.devices.get_mut("d1").unwrap();
        d1.address = Some("ws://127.0.0.1:4403".into());
        let mut d4 = d1.clone();
        d4.name = "Browser".into();
        d4.kind = DeviceKind::Browser;
        d4.address = None;
        d4.runs_executor = false;
        d4.holds_master = HoldsMaster::No;
        rec.devices.insert("d4".into(), d4);
    }
    rec.pending_revocations.clear();
    let store = sk("the identity store");
    let sealed_record = seal_record(&log1.chain, 1, &rec, None, &dev(1), &mut TestRng::new("fixture record")).unwrap();
    let receipt = sign_receipt(log1.chain.id(), &sealed_record, log1.chain.head().seq, &store).unwrap();

    let out = json!({
        "now": LINK_NOW,
        "scid": scid,
        "storeKey": format!("did:key:{}", mk(&store)),
        "browser": {
            "signSeed": hexs(&browser.to_bytes()),
            "signMultikey": mk(&browser),
            "encSecret": hexs(&enc4.to_bytes()),
            "encMultikey": x25519_multikey_of(&enc4),
            "keyId": "d4",
            "r": device_r(),
            "address": address,
            "offerId": link_offer_id(),
        },
        "ticketSealed": sealed_msg,
        "logBefore": log0.json(),
        "logAfter": log1.json(),
        "record": sealed_record,
        "receipt": receipt,
        "executorAddress": "ws://127.0.0.1:4403",
    });
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).unwrap());
}
